verdict.rationale: Entra ID exposes its own programmatic surface through Microsoft Graph, a single REST endpoint with operations such as listing users, plus published machine-readable metadata and a stable versioning policy. This lets automation drive the product without the portal. The evidence never shows the product actually running headlessly or in CI. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive or app-only (service principal) authentication for CI, an official CLI or PowerShell tooling for scripted pipelines, CI integration guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
